The engine keeps a bounded buffer of recent events: a `Last-Event-ID` that is unknown or no longer buffered resumes from the oldest buffered event. Event IDs keep increasing across dropped events and gaps are not signalled, so a client refetches what it shows on every reconnect.

post.description: The member gets the role in the body, the passkey registered with the request and the ticket’s `dashboardUserId`. A wrong code is 422 `access-code-mismatch` and leaves the request pending, except the fifth wrong code for a request, which also deletes it.

post.description: Design only (`live-audio@1`). The voice belongs to the chat: transcripts become its messages with their real authors. One live session per chat at a time. None of the offered formats is 415 `unsupported-media-type`.

post.summary: Open a new engine browser tab at a site for the owner to sign in by hand
post.description: Design only (`browser-tab@1`). The channel carries the tab’s frames out and the owner’s input in. The engine refuses its own origins, origins outside its allowlist, and pages where secrets are typed.

get.summary: Get the onboarding state and the prompt waiting for an answer
get.description: Poll while `status` is `working` or a harness login is `waiting` or `verifying`.

post.summary: Answer the current prompt, or go back one; the engine decides what comes next
post.description: A `promptId` that is not the current prompt is 409 `onboarding-prompt-stale` and changes nothing. An answer of another kind than the prompt is 400 `validation-failed`. A returned login code is never logged or audited.

post.summary: "Skip for now": keep the setup pending, and let the engine set itself up through its built-in agents
post.description: Idempotent. Onboarding stays reachable; answering a prompt later continues where it stopped.

get.summary: The Wallet's state, saved logins without secrets and pending agent requests

post.summary: Save a login; its password and field values can never be read back
post.description: A login for the same origin and username is updated rather than duplicated. The save resolves the pending requests for that origin (and `requestId`), except one-time code requests. A new or changed login stays unverified until the engine tests it. 409 `wallet-not-ready` unless the Wallet is `ready`.

put.summary: Replace one login’s username and password, and change its label or fields

delete.summary: Remove one saved login; other logins are untouched

post.summary: Mark as seen: the request keeps waiting, but stops asking for attention in every client
post.description: Neither an answer nor a refusal. Idempotent for the same step; 409 `wallet-request-moved` when the request moved to another step since it was shown, 404 once it is no longer pending.

post.summary: Reject request: end it; the waiting work learns that nothing was provided
post.description: The work is never told it signed in, and the same request is not raised again for it. 409 `wallet-request-moved` for a stale step, 404 once it is no longer pending.
